What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

Working@AIS
At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Data Scientist. As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Data Scientist.
Project Summary

AIS is currently recruiting for a Data Scientist with an Active Secret clearance for a contract role with a Federal agency in Alexandria, VA. AIS provides a robust capability providing program/administrative support, analyzing fraud complaints, conducting proactive analysis of claims data, and providing specialized investigative support for criminal investigators conducting fraud and corruption investigations throughout the US to include Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and all US territories.

Key Responsibilities
• Provide data science and advanced data analytics to support federal investigations.
• Utilize data mining techniques to find patterns in large data sets.
• •Develop prototype software to meet the needs of specific data analytical tasks.
• Participate in strategic planning sessions with case agents, fraud analytical groups and task forces in an effort to identify fraud and corruption schemes affecting the department.
• Provide expertise in investigations by providing data input to affidavits and subpoenas and recommending possible investigative steps to obtain additional data.
• Compile and analyze large-scale complex data sets, records, investigative files, complaint data and open-source intelligence data, including witness testimony, seized evidence, subpoenaed records/data, business records, contract claims data, in an effort to develop actionable intelligence information to assist in the investigation of fraud cases.
• Help analyze and build profiles/links to identify criminal networks, offenses, suspects, and trends related to complex fraud schemes and patterns.
• Review and analyze various law enforcement, internal, financial, and procurement databases, and conduct open-source searches to obtain necessary records to support complex investigations and prosecutions.
• Input researched and analyzed data into various professional products including analytical summaries, graphs, or charts, and power point presentations for law enforcement use, prosecutions.
• Fully proficient in the use of data science and data analytics software, including but not limited to Python, SAS, Structured Query Language (SQL), i2 Analyst's Notebook, Tableau and Centrifuge.
•

Required For This Opportunity
• Experience should be a minimum of three (3) years in a Data Science role.
• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or directly related science or engineering field.
• An Active Secret clearance.

Nice to Have Skills
• Experience with Databricks
• Experience with Apache Spark
• Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or directly related science or engineering field.

Role: Data Scientist – Contractor

Location: Washington, DC

Duration: 6 months +

Contractor Role Summary:

Opening for a Data Scientist in the Office of Technology (OT). this role will be responsible for applying advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques to complex organizational data to generate actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. The Data Scientist will collaborate with Client Divisions and Offices to identify high-value analytical opportunities, develop predictive and descriptive models, and translate complex data findings into understandable recommendations.

Modern cloud-based data ecosystem and leverage platforms and technologies such as Databricks, Azure, Python, R, SQL, Power BI, MLflow, and Generative AI while adhering to enterprise standards for data governance, security, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI.

Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with Client Divisions and Offices to identify business problems and opportunities that can be addressed through advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical analysis.
• Translate complex business questions into analytical approaches, measurable hypotheses, experiments, models, and data requirements.
• Explore, analyze, and interpret large, complex datasets to identify meaningful trends, relationships, anomalies, patterns, and opportunities.
• Develop descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytical models to support business and operational decision-making.
• Design, develop, test, validate, and deploy machine learning models using appropriate supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
• Apply statistical techniques including regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, hypothesis testing, feature selection, and experimental design.
• Develop reusable analytical pipelines and data science solutions using Python, R, SQL, PySpark, and Databricks.
• Leverage the Databricks Lakehouse platform to perform large-scale data exploration, feature engineering, machine learning, and AI workloads.
• Use MLflow and related MLOps capabilities to track experiments, manage model versions, evaluate model performance, and support controlled production deployment.
• Develop and evaluate Generative AI solutions, including large language model applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language processing, document intelligence, and AI agents where appropriate.
• Establish evaluation methods and metrics to assess the quality, accuracy, reliability, explainability, fairness, and business value of analytical and AI solutions.
• Partner with Data Engineers and Data Architects to define data requirements and ensure that appropriate, high-quality, governed data is available for analytics and AI workloads.
• Identify data quality issues, biases, limitations, and gaps that may affect analytical results or model performance, and work with appropriate teams to remediate issues.
• Develop dashboards, visualizations, reports, analytical products, and data narratives that clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
• Translate highly technical analytical results into concise, actionable information for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
• Develop appropriate technical documentation covering analytical methods, model assumptions, data lineage, training datasets, evaluation results, limitations, and intended use.
• Support model monitoring and periodically evaluate production models for accuracy, performance degradation, data drift, and other risks.
• Follow PCAOB standards for data governance, information security, privacy, records management, model governance, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
• Research emerging technologies and analytical methodologies and recommend opportunities that could enhance PCAOB data and AI capabilities.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Minimum of 4 years of experience supporting technology organizations, IT leadership teams, or government agencies.
• Professional certification in data science, machine learning, Databricks, Microsoft Azure, or artificial intelligence a plus.
• Strong knowledge of statistics, machine learning algorithms, experimental design, predictive modeling, and analytical methodology.
• Deep hands-on expertise with Python and SQL, with experience using R considered beneficial.
• Experience with Python data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
• Hands-on experience with Databricks, including notebooks, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog, and PySpark.
• Experience with cloud analytics and machine learning platforms such as Microsoft Azure and Azure Machine Learning.
• Experience developing and operationalizing machine learning models and familiarity with MLOps concepts.
• Experience preparing, cleansing, transforming, integrating, and analyzing structured and unstructured datasets.
• Familiarity with Generative AI, large language models, embeddings, vector search, RAG, prompt engineering, AI agents, and model evaluation techniques.
• Working knowledge of data visualization and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI.
• Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, model governance, responsible AI, and explainable AI concepts.
• Ability to clearly articulate analytical results and recommendations based on empirical evidence.
• Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to investigate complex or ambiguous business problems.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent analytical efforts with a high degree of autonomy and independent judgment.
• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
• Ability to effectively represent OCOO-OT to internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience developing AI/ML solutions within regulated, government, financial, audit, or other highly governed environments.
• Experience with Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, AI/BI, Genie, vector search, or related AI capabilities.
• Experience with Generative AI and agentic AI solutions.
• Familiarity with agile methods and experience working within cross-functional agile teams.

GDIT delivers critical all‑source intelligence on foreign military and civilian cyber actors, their supporting infrastructure, and the broader ecosystems in which these capabilities operate. This intelligence directly supports foundational military intelligence (FMI) requirements for the joint force and ensures alignment with the mission portfolios.

On this program, GDIT provides a broad range of analytic and mission‑enabling support to produce operationally relevant FMI and scientific and technical intelligence (S&TI) for cyberspace operations. Our support is not limited to analysis; we engage across the entire intelligence cycle planning, collection, processing, exploitation, production, and dissemination while also executing integrated mission management functions.

All support is focused on enhancing the customers’ ability to enable both defensive and offensive cyberspace operations.

Position Overview - Data Scientist (AI/ML Engineer)

The Data Scientist (AI/ML Engineer) designs, implements, and secures production ML systems for classified intelligence missions, including hardened architectures and microservices, containerized/clustered deployments, RMF/OPSEC compliance, model optimization for constrained environments, and integration with mission systems and sensors.

The engineer handles secure code and model practices, performance tuning, and automated secure build/deployment pipelines, coordinating with security/SSO personnel to prevent inadvertent disclosure during agile prototyping. The Data Scientist applies advanced statistical methods, builds semantic automation workflows, strengthens knowledge‑graph reasoning, improves entity extraction and summarization, and performs multi‑INT analytic augmentation via ML. • Evaluate AI, data‑science, and advanced analytic methods for risks, biases, and limitations; deliver incremental enhancements to analytic tools, capabilities, workflows, and methods.
• Perform continuous independent research across government, industry, and academia; investigate, prototype, and evaluate technologies that enhance all‑source intelligence analysis and brief senior leadership on mission applicability.

• Maintain proficiency with TensorFlow/PyTorch, Docker, Kubernetes, GPU/HPC workflows, secure software‑development practices, and model‑optimization techniques; leverage prior ML and automated predictive‑analytics experience and a professional or graduate‑level data‑science certificate.

Education and Desired Experience:

Master’s degree with 12 years related experience or Bachelor’s degree with 17 years’ experience.

Maintain or pursue preferred qualifications including Certified Kubernetes Administrator, cloud GovCloud (AWS/Azure Gov) experience, and RMF/security training.

Principal Associate, Data Scientist - SBB Marketing & Deposit Strategy

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Small businesses make up 99% of U.S. firms and drive 44% of the nation's GDP. At Small Business Bank (SBB), our mission is to advocate for these entrepreneurs and empower their long-term success. The SBB Data Science team brings a relentless focus to the craft of data science—spanning statistics, machine learning, and emerging AI technologies. We partner across the organization to optimize the performance and impact of the financial products, policies, and services delivered to our customers.

• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love

Job Summary:
Socure is the leading provider of digital identity verification and fraud prevention solutions, using AI and machine learning to power accurate identity trust decisions. Our mission is to eliminate identity fraud and ensure online trust across industries.
We are seeking a Data Scientist II to join our Digital Intelligence team. In this role, you will develop machine learning features, analytical methods, and production-oriented risk signals using device, network, browser, mobile, API, session, and behavioral telemetry.
This is a hands-on role for a data scientist who can independently deliver well-scoped projects, work with complex and noisy data, and partner with engineering, product, and risk teams to improve fraud detection, identity confidence, and customer outcomes. You will deepen your expertise in Digital Intelligence while contributing to models and signals used in real-world production decisions.
Job Responsibilities:
• Develop machine learning features, models, and analytical methods for device, network, browser, mobile, session, and behavioral intelligence.

• Work on scoped fraud and identity risk problems where data quality, labels, telemetry coverage, and product tradeoffs need careful analysis.

• Build features from large-scale, high-cardinality, sparse, noisy, and platform-dependent telemetry.

• Analyze signal patterns such as spoofing, emulator behavior, automation, proxy/VPN usage, low-entropy fingerprints, telemetry gaps, and device or session fragmentation.

• Design and execute validation analyses, including train/test splits, holdout checks, leakage review, drift assessment, customer impact analysis, and feature stability review.

• Use supervised, unsupervised, statistical, and heuristic approaches to identify durable fraud and identity risk signals.

• Investigate imperfect labels, delayed outcomes, instrumentation gaps, and changing fraud patterns to distinguish useful signal from data artifacts.

• Partner with senior data scientists, engineering, product, risk, and platform teams to clarify requirements, prepare data, implement features, and support production rollout.

• Contribute to model documentation, feature definitions, explainability materials, dashboards, and production-readiness reviews.

• Communicate methods, assumptions, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Support junior data scientists and analysts through code review, analytical feedback, and sharing effective modeling and validation practices.

Job Requirements:
• Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, statistical modeling, analytics engineering, or a related technical role.

• Experience building, evaluating, and improving machine learning models, features, analytical pipelines, or risk signals.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale, complex datasets.

• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.

• Experience with distributed data processing tools such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or equivalent frameworks.

• Solid understanding of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, statistical validation, and experiment analysis.

• Ability to work with noisy data, imperfect labels, missing values, instrumentation gaps, and changing data distributions.

• Strong analytical judgment across data quality, feature design, model selection, explainability, and business impact.

• Experience collaborating with engineering, product, analytics, or risk teams to move data science work toward production or operational use.

• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work, assumptions, tradeoffs, and results to non-specialist stakeholders.

• Ability to operate independently on defined problem areas while seeking guidance appropriately on ambiguous or high-risk decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Background in fraud detection, identity verification, trust and safety, anomaly detection, cybersecurity, risk modeling, or another adversarial data domain.

• Experience with device intelligence, browser/mobile fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, network intelligence, VPN/proxy detection, or telemetry signal processing.

• Experience developing features from high-cardinality categorical data using techniques such as aggregation, frequency encoding, target encoding, embeddings, graph features, or representation learning.

• Familiarity with production ML workflows, model monitoring, feature monitoring, or batch and near-real-time decisioning systems.

• Experience with dashboarding, model explainability, feature documentation, or customer-impact analysis.

• Interest in adversarial behavior, fraud patterns, telemetry quality, and applied ML systems that operate in real-world production environments.

What You'll Gain
You will work on meaningful data science problems in fraud prevention and identity verification, using high-scale Digital Intelligence telemetry to build features and risk signals that contribute to real-world production decisions.
You will gain deeper experience with device, network, browser, mobile, session, and behavioral intelligence while working closely with senior data scientists, engineering, product, and risk partners. This role offers the opportunity to grow from independently delivering scoped modeling projects toward owning broader workstreams and developing Senior-level technical judgment over time.

The work:

We're looking for a data scientist to build a production resource-allocation capability in Palantir Foundry. You will develop mathematical and simulation models that assemble and compare workforce teams under staffing, qualification, readiness, timing, equipment, and organizational constraints. The application will generate multiple courses of action, explain why alternatives differ, identify infeasible requests, assess organizational impact, and preserve capacity for future demands. This is a production decision-science role—not a reporting or notebook-only position. You will formulate optimization and/or simulation models, write tested Python, integrate models with Foundry Ontology and applications, and work directly with operational and domain experts.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and tune statistical simulation models (e.g., Monte Carlo, Discrete Event, Agent-based modeling) underlying platform scoring.

• Build predictive and forecasting models, including time-series forecasting, to identify future operational trends.

• Conduct uncertainty and sensitivity analyses to quantify confidence in model outputs.

• Partner with subject matter experts to validate model assumptions and improve accuracy over time.

• Benchmark simulation and forecasting models against optimization-based approaches to ensure model validity and cross-validation.

• Evaluate opportunities to apply machine learning as historical data becomes available.

Here is what you need:

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field

• Experience in statistical and simulation modeling, SimPy/AnyLogic/Mesa/SALib or similar

• Strong Python programming skills for statistical/scientific computing

• Ability to work full-time onsite in the DC area

• Must have an Active Secret clearance

• Must be a US Citizen

Preferred experience:

• Experience with linear/mathematical optimization or operations research

• Experience with Palantir Foundry data science tooling.

• Healthcare or public sector domain experience
